case.summary: Transaction 3655457 for $261.51 on card C12223-K1 was flagged due to a legacy real-time risk score of 0.53. Graph analysis confirmed that the transaction took place in-person in region 476 for product category W, aligning perfectly with 93.2% of the card's historical transactions. Recent transaction history demonstrates regular, consistent in-person spending in the same region without any testing bursts or customer dispute. Although the card was linked to a prior compromise in July 2016 (CC-0179), the card was subsequently reissued, and the current holder profile has no confirmed fraud history. The alert is confirmed as a false alarm and the case is closed as legitimate.
